author: Jhnthn
quote: This game was super hyped up, but isn’t delivering what the fans were hoping. I think it’s funny so many people voted this a 10/10 without any gameplay.

author: Jhnthn
quote: This game is very enjoyable and looks stunning. It was great getting to see this in a new light with the added humor. I am glad new gamers got a chance to enjoy this masterpiece.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
